subject: biology
title: A ratio is not a promise.
objective: Distinguish genotype probabilities from guaranteed small-sample counts.
assumptions: One Mendelian locus with two alleles and equal gamete probabilities.
Random gamete union; complete dominance for phenotype mapping.
Probabilities are not guaranteed counts in four offspring.

claims.statement: Distinguish genotype probabilities from guaranteed small-sample counts.
assumptions: One Mendelian locus with two alleles and equal gamete probabilities.
Random gamete union; complete dominance for phenotype mapping.
Probabilities are not guaranteed counts in four offspring.

cues.text: Each parent can contribute A or a with equal probability.
Combine one allele from each parent; keep genotype and trait distinct.
Under complete dominance, what fraction shows the dominant trait?
Three quarters: AA and Aa show the dominant trait in this model.
A 3:1 expectation does not guarantee three out of exactly four.
